blocking_findings.reproduction: Ordinary Python method-closure introspection reached the WeakKeyDictionary-held V14 snapshot state and its mutable StimulusCatalog. Mutating state.catalog._manifests[0].source_relative_path left the cached catalog.sha256 and catalog_sha256 equal, so state.verify passed and validate_static_evidence_plan emitted VALIDATED_STATIC_PLAN_NOT_AUTHORITY_NOT_COMMITTED even though a fresh canonical digest of the current manifests differed from the reported plan digest.

required_next_step: Preserve V14. Repair append-only as V15 so every emitted plan is derived from immutable canonical catalog data or recomputes and verifies the exact current catalog digest at every boundary; eliminate ordinary closure/state reachability that permits stale-digest mutation; keep no-commit, disconnected, default-off behavior; require another different fresh static audit.
